MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL, with normal volatility at 29.2% and very narrow breadth: only 1/8 sectors positive. The volatility reading is moderate, but weak participation limits conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads at 1W: +0.13% | 1M: -7.46%, a RECOVERY; TAVHL (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +3.24%) is ABOVE TREND. Banking & Finance is the next-best sector, but remains BELOW TREND at 1W: -0.99% | 1M: -5.64%.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology & Telecom is weakest at 1W: -10.55% | 1M: -16.49%, BELOW TREND; Construction & REIT and Energy & Chemicals are also BELOW TREND at 1W: -7.89% | 1M: -12.42% and 1W: -7.86% | 1M: -15.09%, respectively.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
TAVHL (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +3.24%) is ABOVE TREND; SAHOL (1W: +4.01% | 1M: -3.29%) and HALKB (1W: +2.79% | 1M: -4.98%) are in RECOVERY. GARAN (1W: +1.61% | 1M: -0.97%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -0.92%) are also in RECOVERY.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: -22.40% | 1M: -35.50%) and TKFEN (1W: -18.09% | 1M: -28.20%) are BELOW TREND. HEKTS (1W: -10.43% | 1M: -17.47%), VESTL (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -31.70%) and GUBRF (1W: -9.34% | 1M: -18.53%) are also BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
The strongest positive weekly moves are TAVHL (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +3.24%), ABOVE TREND, and SAHOL (1W: +4.01% | 1M: -3.29%), in RECOVERY. HALKB (1W: +2.79% | 1M: -4.98%) also shows a short-term RECOVERY.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance remains BELOW TREND, with sector returns of 1W: -0.99% | 1M: -5.64%; individual rebounds are not yet broad confirmation. GARAN (1W: +1.61% | 1M: -0.97%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -0.92%) are in RECOVERY, while ISCTR (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -4.74%) is BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is BELOW TREND at 1W: -4.79% | 1M: -14.38%. EREGL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -3.44%), FROTO (1W: -6.96% | 1M: -15.59%) and TOASO (1W: -8.93% | 1M: -19.68%) are all BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is a major laggard, BELOW TREND at 1W: -7.86% | 1M: -15.09%. TUPRS (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -7.89%), PETKM (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -8.94%) and SASA (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -27.51%) are all BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a defensive, selective stance; NEUTRAL regime and 1/8 positive-sector breadth argue against broad risk additions. Favor confirmed relative strength and require improving breadth before increasing exposure to lagging groups.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Watch TAVHL (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +3.24%), ABOVE TREND, for follow-through; monitor whether SAHOL (1W: +4.01% | 1M: -3.29%) and HALKB (1W: +2.79% | 1M: -4.98%) can extend their RECOVERY. GARAN (1W: +1.61% | 1M: -0.97%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -0.92%) are additional rebound tests.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Transportation for confirmation of its RECOVERY, and Banking & Finance for a broader rebound beyond a few constituents. Energy & Chemicals remains a risk area while sector breadth and returns stay weak.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels or technical support/resistance data were provided, so specific levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a broadening beyond 1/8 positive sectors and sustained stabilization in volatility.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

BIST 50 conditions are NEUTRAL: volatility is normal at 29.2%, but participation is exceptionally narrow at 1/8 positive sectors. Transportation leads, with TAVHL (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +3.24%) ABOVE TREND; energy, technology and construction remain weak, supporting a selective and defensive stance.
